An error from the `package` phase. `sakura explain V8034` prints this explanation offline.

`sakura.lock` lists a package whose files are not there (RFC 0003 §3.2, experimental): a `path`
dependency's directory has no `sakura.toml`, or a registry or git package is not in the vendor
directory or the package cache, which this release does not fill yet. Nothing is fetched by
`check`, `build`, `run` or `test`. Restore the directory, correct the `path` in `sakura.toml`, or
run `sakura sync` once it exists.

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V8034_package_missing/`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V8034_package_missing/), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

`main.sak`:

```sakura
// RFC 0003 §3.2: a locked `path` package whose directory has no sakura.toml is `V8034` at the
// lock entry; nothing is resolved in its place.
pub fn main() -> Unit ! {Console} { Console.print("hi") }
```

`sakura.toml`:

```toml
[package]
name = "billing"

[dependencies]
util = { path = "util" }
```
